verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents several first-party programmatic interfaces: official drivers and APIs for many languages, DuckDB SDKs (Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R, Java), a Postgres-compatible endpoint, and a Wasm client library. A probe also found a published OpenAPI spec at motherduck.com/openapi.json, so an agent or script can drive the product without the UI. Missing for 10: documentation of what the OpenAPI/REST surface covers (e.g. management or admin operations beyond SQL), and independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.
